structuredContent.body:
Twenty NTU partner pages changed their eligibility, TOEFL alternatives, course restrictions, reference costs or links while the official selection list still has 282 blank quotas and six explicit zeros. Refresh the dated reference text and evidence ledger without treating inner-page numbers or undated conditions as confirmed 116-1 selection rules.

For example, Münster displays TOEFL 4.0 alongside 80 and explicitly dated 2027–2028 calendar periods; its current selection quota remains null. Both score scales, Home Edition and subscore qualifiers stay separate. The other 268 partners, all workflows and reminder guards, six-school data, prior source snapshots and catalogue memory fixes remain unchanged. KIT's removed language section stays recorded as requiring confirmation.

The tracked source batch includes official URLs, section before/after text, links, hashes, verification dates and year boundaries. Offline reconstruction and reapplication produce identical bytes. No migration, dependency, infrastructure or schedule changes.

Validation: 86 relevant non-E2E and 11 Chromium tests passed, including updated references at 390px/1440px and existing NTU forms, other-school navigation and stable icons. OpenAPI and exact preservation checks passed. Raw passes and resolved earlier failures are retained in `docs/ntu-update-evidence-20261010/`. Web quality remains `disabled_manually`.

Released merge SHA: `59a20f27fcee00fb597abc79e75ec11778317422`. Existing Render deployment `dep-db4qe3p5efls73a1jg7g` is live with that exact commit. Low-load live acceptance passed: twelve public GETs returned 200; all 288 partner reference rows match the tested bundle; 282 blank/six zero quotas and reminder guards persist; a stateless eligibility calculation keeps unconfirmed schools pending; one anonymous browser session verified both viewports and six-school navigation. The observed post-live interval returned no error-level/5xx logs or failure/restart events. New-instance sampled memory peaked at 374.81 MiB in this short observation.

The separate research handoff contains the fillable 2820-row Excel, candidate JSON, Markdown report, 135 scoped claims and ten conflict rows. Complete current-cycle verification remains zero schools. Library upload failed with HTTP401 before preparation, with no file IDs; the parent instructed no further upload attempts. Research and release receipts are available on the [artifact branch](https://github.com/blizzard-new/abroad/tree/artifacts/ntu-research-20261010/docs/ntu-research-20261010), including the [release acceptance report](https://github.com/blizzard-new/abroad/blob/artifacts/ntu-research-20261010/docs/ntu-research-20261010/release-acceptance/發布驗收與接續說明_2026-10-10.md).
